topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I can't believe it, it's like a punch in the gut, you know? We were inseparable, my heart is still echoing with all those memories. I remember every detail, from the treehouse where we'd whisper our wildest dreams to that one summer we thought we'd conquer the world. It feels so huge, so heavy, that they don't recall any of it. But maybe, just maybe, there's a way to light up those corners, to jog those memories with new stories. I won’t give up on us that easily. We have more to share, more to show, and I’m going to make sure our story isn’t forgotten, not by either of us.
